description: The PB-62 RTO is the administrative transport office for the Jaitu subdivision in Punjab. Operated through the Subdivisional Magistrate (SDM) office, it facilitates vehicle registration, driving license issuance, and road tax collection for the Jaitu area and its rural hinterlands.
address: Subdivisional Magistrate Office, Grain Market, Jaitu, District Faridkot, Punjab
